title: Senior Oracle Security and AI Engineer
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, US Applications will be accepted until November 01, 2026. Job Title: Senior Oracle Security and AI Engineer About the Role This Senior Oracle Security and AI Engineer is primarily responsible for the Oracle Fusion security architecture, role design governance, oversight of the Risk Management Cloud service and AI initiatives. The Engineer serves as a hands-on expert for the technical administration, environment management, and platform integrity of the Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud environment, operating as a technical owner for Oracle Fusion Applications, Security, and the underlying Cloud and AI Infrastructure. Responsibilities Environment Management & Maintenance: Own the technical management of all Fusion environments, including executing scheduled environment refreshes , cloning instances, managing environment usage, and ensuring system configuration baselines. Cloud Update Execution: Participate in the technical preparation and execution of Oracle’s mandatory quarterly cloud updates, including performing pre-update checks and technical smoke testing post-update. Platform Stability & Governance: Own the non-functional requirements for the Oracle Cloud environment, including security architecture, role design governance, and performance benchmarking. Enforce technical configuration control standards. Security Administration: Provide security administration and support for all Oracle Fusion Applications, PaaS and DBaaS platforms. Design, build, and deploy custom security roles for Oracle Fusion Applications, ensuring strict adherence to the principle of least privilege and Segregation of Duties and Sensitive Access compliance frameworks. Risk Management Cloud: Serve as the technical owner of the Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud service. Configure, deploy, and maintain Advanced Access Controls - AAC and Advanced Financial Controls - AFC to detect and mitigate financial risks, fraud, and policy violations, translating audit requirements into effective platform controls. Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Provide Level 2/3 technical support for environment-related issues, access problems, and deployment failures. Serve as an escalation point to conduct root cause analysis for platform-level incidents. AI & Automation Innovation: Evaluate, design, and deploy AI-driven tools, Model Context Protocol implementations/maintenance, Terraform-based automation scripts, and security artifacts to enhance platform security operations, streamline threat monitoring, and optimize governance workflows across the Oracle Cloud ecosystem. Role Requirements Must-Have Skills 8+ years focusing on the technical administration/support within Oracle eco system 4+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying custom security roles within the Oracle Fusion Applications environment. Expert-level knowledge of managing Oracle Fusion Cloud environments(ERP, GTM and EPM), including environment refresh and cloning processes. Deep technical familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure administration and monitoring. Strong understanding of security architecture, Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud, role design governance, and performance management within a cloud ERP. Strong understanding of various MCP and Agentic capabilities with Oracle Fusion (ERP, EPM, GTM), AI Database, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence. Nice-to-Have Skills Experience in an organization transitioning to Oracle Cloud Ecosystem. Hands-on experience with various OCI PaaS Toolsets. Exposure to the Data Center Infrastructure industry Relevant professional product/functional certifications (e.g., Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Security certifications) Skilled in administering DevOps tools like Flexagon FlexDeploy and using Opal IGA tool Experience in Cloudflare’s Developer platform or equivalent(e.g., AWS) What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
